profile.summary: Alameda County Behavioral Health is the county department that provides mental health and substance use services for people with Medi-Cal and for people without insurance. Its services include programs for children and young adults, adults and older adults, crisis response, and substance use treatment and prevention. It also provides school-based behavioral health services.
